verdict.rationale: E2B's pricing page documents an explicit concurrency limit of up to 100 concurrently running sandboxes. The CLI provides fleet-level management: listing sandboxes by state and shutting down single or all running sandboxes. Missing for 10: documentation of limits beyond 100 for truly large fleets (e.g. enterprise or custom tiers), API rate limits on sandbox creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of performance at scale.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run large concurrent fleets of sandboxes with documented concurrency limits

citations.quote: You can shutdown single or all running sandboxes with the E2B CLI.
This will return running sandboxes, you can specify `--state` to get paused or both.
